evidence.notes: Local external-service test harness returns a deterministic HTTP 200 callback response.
Local async HTTP test harness returns a deterministic HTTP 200 response.
Local function mock returns a FunctionInvocation success DTO carrying invocation id and response.
Local function factory returns a FunctionInvocation success DTO.
Local function factory returns a FunctionInvocation error DTO.

source.content: @isTest private class LocalFunctionHttpHarnessTest { @isTest static void contracts() { HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest(); req.setEndpoint('https://example.test/callback'); HttpResponse callback = Test.getExternalService().sendCallback(req); System.assertEquals(200, callback.getStatusCode()); HttpResponse asyncResponse = new TestAsyncHttp().executeHttpRequest(req); System.assertEquals(200, asyncResponse.getStatusCode()); functions.FunctionInvocation ok = functions.MockFunctionInvocationFactory.createSuccessResponse('fn-1', 'done'); System.assertEquals('fn-1', ok.getInvocationId()); System.assertEquals('done', ok.getResponse()); System.assertEquals('SUCCESS', ok.getStatus().name()); functions.FunctionInvocation failed = functions.MockFunctionInvocationFactory.createErrorResponse('fn-2', functions.FunctionErrorType.RUNTIME_EXCEPTION, 'bad'); System.assertEquals('fn-2', failed.getInvocationId()); System.assertEquals('ERROR', failed.getStatus().name()); System.assertEquals('bad', failed.getError().getMessage()); functions.FunctionInvocation mockResult = new functions.FunctionInvokeMock().respond('fn-3', 'payload'); System.assertEquals('fn-3', mockResult.getInvocationId()); System.assertEquals('payload', mockResult.getResponse()); System.assertEquals('SUCCESS', mockResult.getStatus().name()); } }
